comment: Every one of the eight knobs has its own attenuverter and CV jack directly below it, so the eight attenuverters share one line. A four-line feedback delay network with a unitary matrix is lossless at a loop gain of exactly one, which is why the decay knob running to 120 per cent turns the tail into something that feeds on itself until the Chebyshev saturation catches it; decay and absorb therefore interact strongly. configBypass passes each input to its own output. The clock ratio table runs 1/12, 1/8, 1/6, 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 1/1, 3/2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12, with 1 to 1 at noon. The topology follows Tom Erbe's ICMC 2015 paper on the Erbe-Verb. The panel prints antrum, size, pre-delay, decay, absorb, depth, speed, tilt, mix, rev, in l, in r, clk, gate, cv, l and r.
